page0.text:
My frozen body bursts out.
My feet lift me up, and my arms grab the railing at the same time.
I see Tohsaka's face as I do so.
She is biting her lip in frustration, glaring at the tragedy happening below us.

page1.text:
...I know.
It's obvious Tohsaka wants to stop him as well.
But, we'll be the ones killed if we do so. There's no way we can stop him.
That goes the same for me.
I know that it's stupid of me to die trying to save the dying girl.

page2.text:
I don't care about that.
I can't leave that girl be.

page3.text:
That's what overtakes my mind.
I jump over the railing.
Tohsaka and Shinji both look in surprise at the intruder, but that man doesn't even see me jumping down.

page4.text:
The man reaches out to the girl in white.
"...Stop, you bastard...!!!"
I yell at the top of my lungs.
I stop him with all my might.
